en.headline:
Schulte grids.
Quick mental arithmetic.
en.intro: Two small practice spaces: visual search with Schulte grids, and a minute of mental arithmetic.
en.concept: A shuffled board turns a familiar sequence into a visual search task. In the default game, find 1, then 2, then 3, without skipping ahead. The clock stops when you find the final number; a wrong tap counts as a mistake.
en.demo_note: A 3 × 3 introduction, adapted from the app’s grid and ordering rules. This demo does not save a practice result.
en.done: Sequence complete. Try a new grid or open the app.
en.wrong: That is not the next number. Try again.
en.features_title: Same task. Different ways to search.
features: Choose 3 × 3 through 9 × 9; switch digits to letters; use square, colored, circular or Voronoi cells. Direct, reverse and random orders change the sequence you must follow.
The Gorbov preset alternates matching values: black 1, red 1, black 2, red 2. This app’s rule is shown explicitly, so you do not have to guess which color comes next.
Save custom presets. Shuffle on click changes cell positions after a correct tap. Targeted mode becomes available once recorded rounds identify slower values and cells.
en.math_intro: Some questions ask for the result. Others hide an operand. Type the missing number; a correct answer advances automatically. There is no submit button.
en.math_note: Each round lasts 60 seconds. The score is the number of correct answers; mistakes are recorded separately.
en.review_intro: A finish time tells only part of the story. Brain keeps the taps and timing needed to revisit your own sessions.
review: Play, pause or scrub a recorded Schulte round at 0.5×, 1×, 2× or 4×. On pointer devices the replay can also show the recorded cursor path.
Schulte Insights shows timing history, per-number reaction distributions and a spatial heatmap. Quick Math breaks attempts down by operation and response time.
Look at best and average results for the selected settings. A 3 × 3 grid and a 9 × 9 grid are different tasks; faster is meaningful only with that context.
steps: Start with Schulte Grid or Quick Math.
Use Default for a 5 × 5 grid, or open Advanced. For arithmetic, choose Easy, Medium or Hard.
Finish the sequence or the 60-second round, then check the result, replay or Insights.
en.gallery_intro: Real app screens, from choosing a module to reviewing a finished round.
en.runtime: The web app runs in your browser. No account or model API key is needed for either module. Results and presets are stored locally on this browser and origin; they do not sync with another device or the iOS edition.
en.research: Treat the charts as a record of these tasks. A better practice score is not an IQ or health assessment. For the distinction between trained-task gains and broader transfer, see Owen et al.’s controlled study, Putting brain training to the test (2010).
en.local_note: Install dependencies, start Vite, then open the address it prints.
en.family_note: Brain for iOS is the same app family, built for iPhone and iPad. Web history remains separate.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
舒尔特方格，
还有快速心算。
zh.intro: 两个小小的练习空间：用舒尔特方格做视觉搜索，用一分钟做心算。
zh.concept: 打乱的方格把熟悉的顺序变成视觉搜索任务。默认玩法中，依次找到 1、2、3，不能跳过。找到最后一个数字时计时结束；点错会记录为一次失误。
zh.demo_note: 这是根据应用方格和排序规则改编的 3 × 3 介绍演示，不会保存练习成绩。
zh.done: 顺序完成。换一张方格，或打开完整应用。
zh.wrong: 这不是下一个数字，再试一次。
zh.features_title: 同一个任务，不同的搜索方式。
features: 从 3 × 3 到 9 × 9，数字或字母，方形、着色、圆形或 Voronoi 单元。正序、倒序和随机顺序改变需要寻找的序列。
在黑色和红色之间切换
Gorbov 预设交替寻找相同数值：黑 1、红 1、黑 2、红 2。这里明确说明应用自身采用的规则，不必猜测下一种颜色。
可保存自定义预设。开启点击后打乱，每次正确点击都会改变位置。记录足够轮次并识别较慢的数值和格子后，可使用针对性模式。
zh.math_intro: 有的题目求结果，有的题目隐藏一个运算数。输入缺失数字，正确后自动进入下一题，无需提交按钮。
math_difficulty: 加入结果为整数的除法。
zh.math_note: 每轮 60 秒。分数是答对的题数，失误另外记录。
zh.review_title: 回看这一轮是怎样完成的。
zh.review_intro: 完成时间只是其中一部分。Brain 保存点击与计时，让你回看自己的练习过程。
review: 以 0.5×、1×、2× 或 4× 播放、暂停和拖动舒尔特回放。使用指针设备时，还可以查看已记录的光标轨迹。
舒尔特 Insights 展示历史用时、各数字的反应时间分布和空间热图。Quick Math 按运算类型和反应时间分析答题记录。
查看当前设置下的最佳和平均结果。3 × 3 和 9 × 9 是不同任务，比较速度时应保留设置背景。
steps: 从 Schulte Grid 或 Quick Math 开始。
Default 是 5 × 5 方格，也可展开 Advanced。心算则选择简单、中等或困难。
完成序列或 60 秒练习后，查看结果、回放或 Insights。
zh.gallery_intro: 真实应用界面，从选择模块到回顾完成的练习。
zh.runtime: 两个模块都直接在浏览器运行，无需账号或模型 API key。成绩和预设保存在此浏览器、此站点地址的本地存储中，不会同步到其他设备或 iOS 版本。
zh.research: 图表记录的是这些具体任务。练习分数变好，不等同于智商或健康评估。关于任务内进步与更广泛迁移的区别，可阅读 Owen 等人的对照研究 Putting brain training to the test（2010）。
zh.local_note: 安装依赖并启动 Vite，然后打开终端给出的地址。
zh.family_note: Brain iOS 是同系列应用，为 iPhone 和 iPad 构建；网页练习历史独立保存。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
